description:
Preferred 

• At least 4 years of relevant experience in development in following technologies:-Java 1.8+, Spring Framework, Spring Batch, Spring Boot or DropWizard, Restful Services (JAX-RS), Java Testing Frameworks(JUnit, Mockito, PowerMockito), Relational DB (preferably Oracle), Microservices, Git, Jenkins, Understanding of Cloud infrastructure, JPA/JDBI or Mybatis.
• Additionally knowledge of following technologies would be an advantage:Docker Framework, Document Based DBs – Cassandra, Couchbase or Mongo, Redis DB, SonarQube, Kafka, Loadrunner, Jira, Confluence, Cucumber, Kubernetes (or similar technology), ELK Integration (Elasticsearch, Logstash & Kibana)
• At least 2 years of experience developing enterprise grade highly scalable Java based applications.
• At least 2 years of experience in Agile. Knowledge of ceremonies. CSM® or PMI ACP® will be added advantage.
• At least 2 years of experience in Design and architecture of JEE applications
• Ability to work in team in diverse/ multiple stakeholder environment
• Experience in Credit Card Loyalty Program would be an advantage
• Good analytical skills 
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 Basic 
 
 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. 
 • At least 4 years of experience with Information Technologies 


 Additional Information 

** U.S. citizens and those authorized to work in the U.S. are encouraged to apply. 

 Note:- 

1.This is a Full-Time Permanent job opportunity for you.
2.Only US Citizen, Green Card Holder can apply.
3.No OPT-EAD & H1B Consultants please.
4.Please mention your Visa Status in your email or resume.
